title: Phool Bane Angaray
desc: Ranjit Singh uncovers strong evidence against a corrupt politician, putting himself at risk, while his wife courageously joins the police force to help him fight for justice.

title: Main Tulsi Tere Aangan Ki
desc: Thakur Rajnath loves Tulsi, a former prostitute, but marries Sanjukta to please his mother. After Tulsi's death, Sanjukta faces a dilemma when she discovers Ajay's wrongdoing. What will she choose?

title: 16Th December
desc: Four Indian Revenue Service officers race against time to track and intercept Pakistani terrorists plotting a nuclear attack on New Delhi, risking everything to prevent disaster.

title: F.A.L.T.U
desc: Four underachieving friends create a fake university after failing exams, but their risky lie spirals into chaos as reality catches up with their desperate attempt to secure a future.

title: Super Singh
desc: Super Singh, a carefree man living with his mother in Canada, gains superpowers and returns to Punjab to battle drug lords and corrupt politicians threatening his homeland.

title: Article 15
desc: Senior police officer Ayaan Ranjan has to come to grips with the reality of caste discrimination in the rural heartlands of India when a gruesome and unjust rape and murder case lands on his desk.

title: Mom
desc: Devki, a biology teacher, turns to private detective DK after her stepdaughter's rapists are acquitted. Fueled by anguish, she vows revenge and sets out to deliver justice herself.

title: Socha Na Tha
desc: Viren cant imagine having an arranged marriage. His parents want him to meet Aditi. They refuse to get married but stay friends. Will Cupid strike and change their minds?

title: Shirdi Ke Sai Baba
desc: A doctor visits Shirdi with his ailing son, torn between faith and science. To save his child, he must decide if Sai Baba's blessings hold the cure he desperately seeks.

title: Inteqaam
desc: After his sister Chhaya is raped and justice denied, Birju loses his parents to grief. Fueled by rage, he seeks revenge by kidnapping Dinanath's sister.

title: Aitraaz
desc: Raj, a married man, is falsely accused of rape by his ex-girlfriend, now his boss's wife. Pushed to the edge, he fights back by suing her for sexual harassment despite pressure.

title: Kismat Konnection
desc: Raj, a struggling architect, and Priya, a disillusioned activist, cross paths. Destiny connects them in surprising ways, leading to love, hope, and a chance at new beginnings.

title: Judaai
desc: Driven by greed, Kajal urges her honest husband Raj to marry his boss's wealthy daughter Janhvi, but her plan triggers unforeseen consequences that threaten their lives.

title: Double Dhamaal
desc: Four idlers dream of wealth by investing in buildings. Kabir cons them, leaving them broke. Determined, they set out to avenge their humiliation and reclaim dignity.

title: Agent Vinod
desc: Agent Vinod uncovers a chilling truth: his colleague's death was orchestrated by a powerful business elite. As tensions rise, he must navigate danger to seek justice and uncover the conspiracy.

title: Crook
desc: Jai, a small-time crook equipped with a new identity, is sent to Australia by his uncle. However, there he gets embroiled in the ongoing racial conflict while also trying to pursue his love interest.
